arguments.subject: Re: Invoice INV-4471 dispute with Lumen Supplies
arguments.body:
Dear Billing Team,

We are writing to clarify the invoice INV-4471 for Lumen Supplies. According to our purchase order PO-7782, we authorized only 32 units at 460 TND per unit, totaling 14,720 TND. However, the invoice is for 40 units, which amounts to 18,400 TND. The disputed difference is 3,680 TND.

Please find the purchase order (DOC-3101) and the delivery note (DOC-3102) for reference. We kindly request a resolution to this discrepancy.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,
Amira Bensalah
